47:         .get_many::<OsString>(options::SETS)

49:         .flatten()

51:         .collect();
52: 
53:     let sets_len = sets.len();
54: 
55:     if sets.is_empty() {
56:         return Err(UUsageError::new(1, "missing operand"));
57:     }
58: 
59:     if !(delete_flag || squeeze_flag) && sets_len < 2 {
60:         return Err(UUsageError::new(
61:             1,
62:             format!(
63:                 "missing operand after {}\nTwo strings must be given when translating.",
64:                 sets[0].quote()
65:             ),

67:     }

74:                 sets[0].quote()
75:             ),
76:         ));
77:     }
78:

90:             };

92:         }
93:         if sets_len > 2 {
94:             let op = sets[2].quote();
95:             let msg = format!("{} {}", start, op);
96:             return Err(UUsageError::new(1, msg));
97:         }

132:         os_str_as_bytes(sets_iter.next().unwrap_or_default())?,

134:         complement_flag,

146:             translate_input(&mut locked_stdin, &mut buffered_stdout, op);
147:         } else {

149:             translate_input(&mut locked_stdin, &mut buffered_stdout, op);
